"""Prospective method-wording correction from root independent static review.

Only two production string literals change. No financial/native capabilities.
"""
import ast
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=HERE.parents[1]
OLD=ROOT/'.tmp/ex058-param-prototype'
NEW=ROOT/'.tmp/ex058-param-prototype-v2'
CHECKS=ROOT/'.tmp/ex058-param-checks'
FILES=('run_parameters.py','parameter_analysis.py','pair_parameters.py','declare_geometry.py')

POLICY_OLD='Existing prepared S013 assets only; original raw ACF20/score/range/rawregime requirements and parent warmup exactly unchanged. Body uses current signalClose/Open, previous complete daily rawregime uses shift1 before reindex; max(parent,regimeW+2) is required. All full13 domains retained; existing prepared history shortage FAILED. No fill, fallback, download, point replacement or automatic retry.'
POLICY_NEW='Existing prepared S013 assets only; original raw ACF20/score/range/rawregime requirements unchanged. Effective warmup is unchanged at original center and all same32 canonical parameter points only. Full13 domains require max(parent,regimeW+2) for previous complete daily rawregime shifted before reindex; W60/ranges21/L40 corner requires62 instead of original61. Body uses current signalClose/Open; all full13 domains retained and existing prepared history shortage FAILED. No fill, fallback, download, point replacement or automatic retry.'
SCOPE_OLD='Registered original C2132 is IMPLEMENTATION parent. Original raw ACF20 statistic/confirmation and all13 numerical centers remain. Eligibility is range AND momentum AND (original rawACFpass OR selected flatrawbear priorfinalbearTIME BELOW BODY-up plus bullboundary BODY restriction recovery); originalACFpass bear entries have no BODY veto; bull boundary BODY guard is explicit, recovery includes no new score condition; original threshold remains unchanged, original confirmation still required, holding has no exception. Context persists flat/rawroute changes and is consumed by any signalentry; all original holding exits/H remain.'
SCOPE_NEW='Registered original C2132 is IMPLEMENTATION parent. Original raw ACF20 statistic/confirmation and all13 numerical centers remain. Bear eligibility is range AND momentum AND (original rawACFpass OR selected flatrawbear priorfinalbearTIME strictBELOW BODY-up recovery). Independently, flat enhancedeligible currentrawbull/previousrawbear boundary entry requires BODY-up AND original confirmation; stablebull retains original entry. OriginalACFpass bear entries have no BODY veto. Recovery adds no score0 gate or new score condition; original threshold and confirmation remain required everywhere. Holding has no exception. Context persists flat/rawroute changes and is consumed by any signalentry; all original holding exits/H remain.'


def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    frozen=json.loads((CHECKS/'freeze_snapshot.json').read_text('utf-8'))
    assert frozen['status']=='SOURCE_READY'
    for name, expected in frozen['files'].items():
        assert digest(ROOT/name)==expected, ('Frozen v1 drift',name)
    NEW.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    original=(OLD/'run_parameters.py').read_text('utf-8')
    for text in (POLICY_OLD,SCOPE_OLD):
        assert original.count(text)==1
    corrected=original.replace(POLICY_OLD,POLICY_NEW).replace(SCOPE_OLD,SCOPE_NEW)
    (NEW/'run_parameters.py').write_text(corrected,encoding='utf-8')
    for name in FILES[1:]:
        (NEW/name).write_bytes((OLD/name).read_bytes())
    focused=(CHECKS/'focused_checks.py').read_text('utf-8')
    assert focused.count('SOURCE = ROOT / ".tmp/ex058-param-prototype"')==1
    (HERE/'focused_checks.py').write_text(focused.replace(
        'SOURCE = ROOT / ".tmp/ex058-param-prototype"',
        'SOURCE = ROOT / ".tmp/ex058-param-prototype-v2"'),encoding='utf-8')
    restoration={POLICY_NEW:POLICY_OLD,SCOPE_NEW:SCOPE_OLD}
    class Restore(ast.NodeTransformer):
        changed=0
        def visit_Constant(self,node):
            if isinstance(node.value,str) and node.value in restoration:
                node.value=restoration[node.value]
                self.changed+=1
            return node
    restorer=Restore()
    tree=restorer.visit(ast.parse(corrected))
    assert restorer.changed==2
    assert ast.dump(tree,include_attributes=False)==ast.dump(ast.parse(original),include_attributes=False)
    assert corrected.replace(POLICY_NEW,POLICY_OLD).replace(SCOPE_NEW,SCOPE_OLD)==original
    assert all((NEW/name).read_bytes()==(OLD/name).read_bytes() for name in FILES[1:])
    result={'status':'PURE_CORRECTION_PASS','reason':'Root independent static review identified two misleading method descriptions; economic logic unchanged.',
            'changes':[{'field':'preparation failure policy','old':POLICY_OLD,'new':POLICY_NEW},
                       {'field':'implementation_parent scope','old':SCOPE_OLD,'new':SCOPE_NEW}],
            'exact_restored_whole_AST':True,'exact_restored_whole_text':True,
            'three_other_helpers_byteexact':True,'v1_all_frozen_files_sha256_verified':len(frozen['files']),
            'v1_freeze_sha256':digest(CHECKS/'freeze_snapshot.json'),
            'v1_focused_sha256':digest(CHECKS/'focused.json'),
            'source_files':{name:digest(NEW/name) for name in FILES},
            'correction_source_sha256':digest(Path(__file__)),
            'native_account_reads':0,'market_reads':0,'new_account_preparations':0,
            'new_account_evaluations':0,'provider_calls':[],'publications':0,'registrations':0}
    path=HERE/'correction.json'
    assert not path.exists()
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'v1_frozen_files_verified':result['v1_all_frozen_files_sha256_verified']}))


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

"""Pure helper tests; all financial/native read, prepare/evaluate/publish are spies."""

from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import inspect
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import types
from unittest.mock import patch

import optuna
from strategy_evaluator import (
    AssessmentCandidate,
    ParameterCoordinate,
    ParameterCoordinateKind,
    ParameterDesignRequest,
    ParameterPerturbationProtocol,
    ParameterSpace,
    build_parameter_perturbation_design,
)
from strategy_manager import CandidateKey
from czsc_trader.research_tools import EvaluationLineage, ParameterEvaluationPlan


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = next(parent for parent in HERE.parents if (parent / "research/S013/experiments").is_dir())
SOURCE = ROOT / ".tmp/ex058-param-prototype-v2"


def main():
    checks, financial_calls, writes = [], [], {}

    def check(name, condition):
        assert condition, name
        checks.append(name)

    def refuse(name, callback):
        try:
            callback()
        except (AssertionError, ValueError, TypeError):
            checks.append(name)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected explicit refusal: " + name)

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        financial_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        raise AssertionError("Financial account operation or read forbidden")

    common = types.ModuleType("common")
    for name, value in {
        "ROOT": ROOT,
        "SRC": SOURCE,
        "CACHE": HERE / "no-native-cache",
        "PROTOCOLS": HERE / "no-formal-protocols",
        "RUNS": HERE / "no-financial-runs",
        "EXPERIMENT": types.SimpleNamespace(experiment_id="EX058_PROTOTYPE"),
        "SOURCE_CALLS": [],
        "cache_read": forbidden,
        "cache_write": forbidden,
        "read": forbidden,
        "write": lambda path, value: writes.update({str(path): deepcopy(value)}),
        "file_hash": lambda _path: "a" * 64,
        "context": lambda _workers=1: types.SimpleNamespace(
            evaluation=types.SimpleNamespace(
                prepare=forbidden, evaluate=forbidden, evaluate_many=forbidden
            )
        ),
    }.items():
        setattr(common, name, value)
    sys.modules["common"] = common
    for name, attributes in {
        "account_reference": {"verify_account": forbidden},
        "analysis_reference": {"annual": forbidden},
        "boundary_recovery_oracle": {"audit_boundary_recovery": forbidden},
    }.items():
        module = types.ModuleType(name)
        module.__dict__.update(attributes)
        sys.modules[name] = module

    def load(name):
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, SOURCE / (name + ".py"))
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module

    runner, analysis, pairs, declaration = (
        load(name)
        for name in ("run_parameters", "parameter_analysis", "pair_parameters", "declare_geometry")
    )
    parent_plan = json.loads(
        (ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX012_20261011/protocols/plan.json").read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )
    center = next(
        row["payload"]["parameters"]
        for row in parent_plan["configurations"]
        if row["candidate_id"] == "C2132"
    )
    original_geometry = json.loads(
        (ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX046_20261011/protocols/geometry.json").read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )
    geometry = declaration.build_geometry(original_geometry)
    for key in ("protocol", "coordinates", "origins", "mapping", "feasibility"):
        check(
            "original complete geometry unchanged " + key, geometry[key] == original_geometry[key]
        )
    check(
        "new RAW BELOW oracle vs frozen legacy oracle distinct",
        "boundary_recovery_oracle_sha256" in geometry
        and geometry["legacy_direction_oracle"]["path"].endswith(
            "EX043_20261011/src/direction_oracle.py"
        ),
    )
    check(
        "prospective reservation consistent",
        geometry["candidate_reservation"]
        == {"first": runner.RESERVED_FIRST, "last": runner.RESERVED_LAST}
        == {"first": 8840, "last": 8871},
    )
    check(
        "registered implementation parent is original",
        "row['label'] == 'B0-TIME'"
        in inspect.getsource(runner.implementation_parent).replace('"', "'"),
    )
    identifiers = [8880, *range(8840, 8872)]
    assert len(identifiers) == 33 and len(set(identifiers)) == 33
    for identifier in identifiers:
        CandidateKey("S013", f"C{identifier:04d}")
    check("all33 IDs strong CandidateKey contract only, not collision approval", True)
    check(
        "public plan methods exist",
        callable(ParameterEvaluationPlan.create)
        and callable(ParameterEvaluationPlan.bind_point)
        and "dataflows" in inspect.signature(ParameterEvaluationPlan.create).parameters,
    )
    check(
        "public lineage supports derivation and parameter binding",
        {"derivation", "parameter_binding"} <= set(inspect.signature(EvaluationLineage).parameters),
    )
    protocol = ParameterPerturbationProtocol(**geometry["protocol"])
    designs = []
    for label, candidate in (("B0-TIME", "C2132"), ("B0-COUPLED", "C4900"), ("N0", "C8880")):
        space = ParameterSpace(
            tuple(
                ParameterCoordinate(
                    name,
                    float(runner.get_path(center, name)),
                    low,
                    high,
                    ParameterCoordinateKind(kind),
                )
                for name, low, high, kind in geometry["coordinates"]
            ),
            "a" * 64,
            "b" * 64,
        )
        result = build_parameter_perturbation_design(
            ParameterDesignRequest(
                AssessmentCandidate("S013-" + candidate, "c" * 64), protocol, space
            ),
            feasibility=runner.feasible,
        )
        assert result.status.value == "COMPLETE"
        designs.append(result.design)
    check(
        "public full13 three-center same32 coordinates",
        all(
            design.space.coordinates == designs[0].space.coordinates
            and design.points == designs[0].points
            for design in designs
        ),
    )
    p = {**deepcopy(center), "mechanism": "RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY"}
    for point in designs[2].points:
        materialized = runner.materialize(p, geometry, point.coordinates)
        assert materialized["mechanism"] == p["mechanism"]
        assert runner.feasible(point.coordinates)
        for name, _low, _high, kind in geometry["coordinates"]:
            value = runner.get_path(materialized, name)
            assert type(value) is (int if kind == "INTEGER" else float)
        assert p == {**center, "mechanism": "RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY"}
    check("all32 materialization preserves types and original base", True)
    check(
        "native alias cache isolation",
        runner.point_cache("B0-COUPLED", "N0-P00") != runner.point_cache("N0", "N0-P00"),
    )
    refuse("invalid cache label", lambda: runner.point_cache("N0", "N0-P00/../bad"))
    refuse("invalid control alias", lambda: runner.point_cache("OLD", "N0-P00"))
    manifest = {"reused_rows": [{"label": str(index)} for index in range(64)]}
    state = {"rows": deepcopy(manifest["reused_rows"])}
    reused_count = len(manifest["reused_rows"])
    trial_numbers = []
    optuna.logging.set_verbosity(optuna.logging.WARNING)
    study = optuna.create_study(
        direction="maximize", sampler=optuna.samplers.RandomSampler(seed=13)
    )
    for index in range(32):
        study.enqueue_trial({"point": index})
    for index in range(32):
        trial = study.ask()
        assert trial.suggest_int("point", 0, 31) == index
    for offset in range(0, 32, 8):
        for index in range(offset, offset + 8):
            trial_index = runner.trial_index(reused_count + index, reused_count)
            study.tell(trial_index, float(index))
            trial_numbers.append(trial_index)
            state["rows"].append({"label": "N0-P" + str(index)})
    check(
        "32 unique fixed Optuna trials 4batches8 no alias mutation",
        trial_numbers == list(range(32))
        and len(state["rows"]) == 96
        and len(manifest["reused_rows"]) == 64
        and all(trial.state.name == "COMPLETE" for trial in study.trials),
    )
    for global_index in (63, 96):
        refuse(
            "trial outside fixed32 " + str(global_index),
            lambda value=global_index: runner.trial_index(value, 64),
        )
    refuse("mutating reused count not accepted", lambda: runner.trial_index(65, 65))
    experiment = {
        "controls": [{"label": "B0-TIME"}, {"label": "B0-COUPLED"}],
        "configurations": [
            {
                "label": "N0",
                "mechanism": "RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY",
                "parent_control": "B0-TIME",
            }
        ],
    }
    for qualified in (False, True):
        result = runner.select_new_centers(experiment, {"rows": {"N0": {"qualified": qualified}}})
        check(
            "center selection only original four-gate flag " + str(qualified),
            bool(result) is qualified,
        )
    wrong = deepcopy(experiment)
    wrong["configurations"][0]["parent_control"] = "B0-COUPLED"
    refuse(
        "historical coupled is not implementation parent",
        lambda: runner.select_new_centers(wrong, {"rows": {"N0": {"qualified": True}}}),
    )

    # Invoke actual no-qualification branches, with all account/API capabilities
    # replaced by refusal spies. Source validation is supplied as frozen metadata.
    no_qualification = {
        "status": "PASS",
        "rows": {key: {"qualified": key != "N0"} for key in ("B0-TIME", "B0-COUPLED", "N0")},
    }
    for label in ("B0-RAW-RECOVERY", "B0-BULL-BOUNDARY"):
        no_qualification["rows"][label] = {"qualified": False}
    material_calls = []

    def fake_publish(_ctx, name, value):
        material_calls.append((name, deepcopy(value)))
        return types.SimpleNamespace(to_dict=lambda: {"pure_spy": True})

    with (
        patch.object(runner, "source_check", lambda: (experiment, geometry)),
        patch.object(runner, "read", lambda _path: no_qualification),
        patch.object(runner, "publish_material", fake_publish),
    ):
        runner.declare()
    not_applicable = writes[str(runner.MANIFEST)]
    check(
        "unqualified declaration zero preparations/evaluations/reuse",
        not_applicable["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE"
        and all(
            not_applicable[key] == 0
            for key in (
                "new_parameter_business_accounts",
                "reused_parameter_accounts",
                "actual_parameter_evaluations",
                "planned_actual_parameter_evaluations",
                "technical_duplicate_evaluations",
            )
        ),
    )
    with (
        patch.object(runner, "source_check", lambda: (experiment, geometry)),
        patch.object(runner, "read", lambda _path: not_applicable),
    ):
        runner.precheck()
        runner.run()
    with (
        patch.object(analysis, "source_check", lambda: (experiment, geometry)),
        patch.object(analysis, "read", lambda _path: not_applicable),
    ):
        analysis.main()
